preconditions.description: The input S must be a string.
The length of the string S must be between 1 and 10^6.

postconditions.description: The output must be the integer value returned by the function.
The number of characters to be added must be non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(S[i] == S[-i-1] for i in range(len(S) - return_value))
postconditions.description: The modified string must be a palindrome after adding the minimum characters to the front.
